name: Riot City 🚨 Prison Escape
desc:
Welcome to Riot City! Escape prison, become a criminal, rob the bank, collect cars and guns, or enforce the law as a cop and arrest criminals!

🚨 October 23rd Update:
🏎️ NEW Fetuccini Tamarindo!
🏎️ NEW LIMITED Demonio 13!
🐛 Bug Fixes!

👮‍♂️ Riot City is the ultimate cops vs prisoners experience on Roblox. Jump into a massive open-world city where every session is a battle between chaos and justice. Start as a prisoner, break out, build your criminal empire, pull off robberies, escape high-speed police chases, and dominate the streets. Or join the police force, gear up, hunt down dangerous criminals, shut down heists, and restore order across the city. With 20+ vehicles and 15+ guns to collect, Riot City is packed with action, progression, and deep customization. Build your perfect ride with vehicle upgrades and customization options, expand your arsenal, and battle on either side of the law

🌟 Premium: +10% money! 🌟
🌟 Riot City Studio group members: +10% money! 🌟
